fact: On 8 and 9 June 2026 a Stakeholder Engagement Workshop of 60 participants was held in Brazzaville with the Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and the Digital Economy, after consultations with 21 institutions including civil society and the private sector, to inform the National Data Governance Strategy.
title: Building the foundations of a trusted data ecosystem in the Republic of the Congo
publisher: United Nations Economic Commission for Africa
